title: Admin User Authentication & Role-Based Access
businessObjective: Allow Human Resources Administrators to securely access OrangeHRM with administrator credentials to manage personnel records, configure system settings, and approve requests.
preconditions: The user possesses a valid administrator account in OrangeHRM.
The user is on the OrangeHRM login page.

mainFlow.action: Enter a valid administrator username in the Username field.
Enter the corresponding valid password in the Password field.

mainFlow.expected: User is redirected to the Dashboard page.

alternateFlows.name: Invalid Credentials
steps: User enters a username and/or password that does not match any administrator account.
System validates the credentials, determines they are invalid, and displays an error alert "Invalid credentials" without indicating which field is incorrect.

alternateFlows.name: Missing Required Fields
steps: User leaves the Username and/or Password field empty.
System detects empty required fields and displays inline validation messages "Required" next to each empty field.

alternateFlows.name: Forgot Password Navigation
steps: User clicks the "Forgot your password?" link.
System navigates to the password reset request screen.

exceptionFlows.name: System Unavailable
exceptionFlows.condition: Authentication service is unreachable or returns an error.
exceptionFlows.action: Display a generic error message "Unable to process login at this time. Please try again later." and log the incident for investigation.

exceptionFlows.name: Session Timeout During Login
exceptionFlows.condition: User remains idle on the login page beyond the session timeout limit.
exceptionFlows.action: Refresh the login page and prompt the user to re-enter credentials.

dataRequirements.rules: Required; maximum length 50 characters; must match an existing administrator account.
Required; minimum length 8 characters; must be stored and transmitted using secure hashing and TLS.

acceptanceCriteria: Valid username and password should authenticate successfully and redirect to the Dashboard page.
Invalid username or password should display an error alert "Invalid credentials" without revealing which field was incorrect.
Submitting empty username or password fields should display inline validation messages "Required".
Clicking "Forgot your password?" should navigate to the password reset request screen.
nonFunctionalRequirements: Authentication response time shall not exceed 2 seconds under normal load.
All credential transmission must be encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher.
Authentication attempts shall be logged with timestamp, username, IP address, and outcome for audit purposes.
The login page shall be accessible in compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
